messages.content: who were critics of nicolaus copernicus Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced.

message.content: Nicolaus Copernicus faced criticism from several notable figures. Johannes Kepler initially believed the heliocentric system was inferior to Ptolemy's. Galileo Galilei initially had reservations about the system. The Church and various religious authorities were critical of his ideas. Who else challenged Copernicus's work? The impact of his ideas was truly groundbreaking! How did his critics view his model? It challenged centuries of established astronomical thought! Did any contemporary astronomers challenge his work? His model transformed our understanding of the cosmos!
